name: arcane
description: Modern Docker Management, Designed for Everyone
one_liner: A friendly dashboard for people who run Docker containers, so you can see and manage everything running on your server without memorizing command-line commands.
buyer: A small IT consultant or self-hosting hobbyist managing a handful of home-lab or small-business servers who wants a GUI instead of the terminal.
business_use_cases: An IT consultant managing several small-business servers uses it to give non-technical clients a simple dashboard to restart their own services.
A self-hosting hobbyist runs their home media server and apps through it without learning Docker CLI commands.
A small web host offers managed Docker hosting to clients with this as the friendly front-end.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a managed hosting plan where this dashboard is pre-installed and the customer just picks apps to run

steal_this: Package a pre-configured VPS image with Arcane installed and a handful of popular self-hosted apps ready to click-install, and sell it as 'your own cloud, no DevOps needed'.
